mapper.select: SELECT vdate, mdate, payDate, payStatus FROM ( SELECT FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE AS vdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE AS mdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AS payDate, '已付息' AS payStatus FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE IFNULL(PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID) = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{no,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Trade_Status = #{tradeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS in (#{ps,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps2,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps3,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps4,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) UNION ALL SELECT FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE AS vdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE AS mdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AS payDate, '未付息' AS payStatus FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE IFNULL(PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID) = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{no,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Trade_Status = #{tradeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS in (#{ps,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps2,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps3,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps4,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) zz order by mdate asc
